about_the_game:
Don't Forget to Smile

A Bullet Heaven Roguelike About Breaking Free

This isn't just a game—it's a raw, unfiltered scream against the soul-crushing grind of minimum wage work and the suffocating corporate machine.

Do you ever feel like it’s all too much? Like the game is rigged from the start? Your "manager" is lording over you for being three minutes late, your job is a cycle of mindless tasks, and life is slipping through your fingers. Welcome to your breaking point.

Live the Psychotic Break.

Don't Forget to Smile is a fast-paced survivors-like bullet heaven where you fight through relentless waves of enemies. Armed with weapons inspired by - and mocking - industry and technology, you’ll level up and expand your arsenal.

Demo Features

• 2 Weapons with 2 to Unlock

• 2 Augments with 2 to Unlock

• Reduced shop content

• Level 1 only

Key Features in Full Game

• 10+ Weapons to unlock, forged from the tools of industry and oppression.
• 15+ Augments to unlock, infused with industrial tech and medicine.
• Upgrade Shop (No, not real money! No microtransactions here)
• Hidden Synergies between weapons and augments unleash devastating effects.
• 5+ Levels depicting the bleak reality we inhabit.
• A Satirical Take on corporate culture, mental health, and the human condition.

Claw your way up the corporate ladder.

Work your way up and out of the corporate ladder, smearing your oppressors across the screen as you shoot, stun, electrify, burn, explode, slap and squash your way to the good life.

All brought to life through a unique blend of hand-drawn artwork, 3D renders, and 2D animation.

Coming 2025 – More Chaos Incoming:

• Steam Achievements

• Controller Support

• Localisations

• Leaderboards

• Performance Optimizations

• More Weapons & Augments

Want in early? Join the rebellion. Get involved with private playtesting and discussions on our support channels!

Note from the developer

Hello! I'm Jamie and I am a solo dev - along with my trusty sound guy Frank - working on this in my spare time, your following, wishlisting and sharing of this game is greatly appreciated. Thanks.

content_descriptors.notes: The game is centered around the player breaking out of their day to day role and going on a killing spree. The deaths are not realistic, but stylised and excessively bloody.

short_description: Welcome to Don't Forget to Smile – the game that throws you into an adrenaline-fueled, anxiety-ridden trip through the darkest corners of modern life. 10+ weapons, 15+ augments, synergies and upgrades will help you break out of your day to day and fight back.
